## Title
Add account role (Student/company) on signup.

## Description
**Summary:**
Add a role selector to signup (Student or Company).

**Details**
In the process of signing up users get to chose the role they identify as, either as a student looking for an internship role or as a company looking to hire talents.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Signup form includes radio/select for role.
- [ ] User record includes role field.
- [ ] Login flow reads role.

## Size
S (Small) - 1-3 hours

## Labels
enhancement, backend
